# Name: Location for Logan River at Mendon Road (600 South)
# Description: A datastream of Discharge at Logan River at Mendon Road (600 South) (1.5 processing level) converted to cubic feet per second.
# Description: Discharge is calculated from water level data with a site specific rating curve that relates water level to discharge based on discrete field observations.
# MethodType: Data derived from instrument deployment
# Definition: Discharge is the volumetric flow rate of water moving through a stream or river cross section.
# Explanation: Quality controlled data that is subject to change upon further review.
# Output date/time values are in UTC unless they were input to HydroServer without time zone offset information. In that case
